findings.savingNote: estimated reduction on the cited workload
findings.shareNote: the annualised saving against the spend this window priced
findings.annualised: A year at this run rate
findings.annualisedNote: projection if the same workload repeats for 365 days
findings.spendNote: the span the listed findings cover

strip.label: Share of the identified savings by finding

findings.facts: {findings} findings · {operators} operators involved · {high} high confidence · {medium} medium
findings.note: Potential savings compare recorded costs with an alternative on the cited calls. They are estimates, not savings already achieved. Review the calculation and proposed change before acting.
findings.empty: No open finding matches the supported patterns in the available data. Missing usage or prices can prevent a cost estimate.

evidence.atStakeNote: estimated reduction on the cited workload
evidence.coveredNote: the rest are cited and add nothing to the saving
evidence.tokensNote: what the covered calls carried, against the alternative
evidence.counterfactual: What the alternative would have cost
evidence.runs: The cited runs with the largest saving
evidence.runsEmpty: The evidence lists no run for this finding.
evidence.note: Every run above is a sealed record. Open one to read the frames the arithmetic came from.

fix.title: Review the recommended change
fix.body: Review the recommendation before changing instructions, a harness, or a tool. Recording a fix only updates this finding. It does not edit code, open a pull request, or measure realised savings.
fix.dismissNote: A dismissed finding keeps its evidence and the decision. The job opens it again only on runs that start after it.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your organization role cannot decide a finding. An organization owner or admin records a fix or dismisses it.
failure.noPrincipal: The request carried no signed-in user. Sign in and try again.
failure.notOpen: This finding was already decided. Nothing was changed.
failure.notFound: This finding no longer exists. Nothing was changed.
failure.pendingApproval: The decision is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.invalid: The decision was refused as invalid. Nothing was changed.
failure.refused: The decision was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.unavailable: The decision could not be recorded: {code}. Nothing was changed.

fix.contextBody: For an instruction or workflow change, review the finding and recommendation in the context-record wizard. Nothing is published until you review and merge its pull request.
fix.codeBody: Review a request for Stella to inspect the finding and plan a harness hook, custom tool, or code change. Opening a pull request depends on the repository tools and access available to Stella.
fix.effort: Implementation cost is not estimated. Potential savings exclude the cost of making the change.
fix.codeAction: Plan a code PR with Stella
fix.codeDraft:
Inspect this spend finding and read the cited calls before proposing a change. Plan the smallest harness hook, custom tool, or code fix that addresses the behavior, with tests. Separate measured costs from potential savings. Estimate implementation cost only with stated assumptions. Open a reviewable code PR only if repository tools and access are available. Otherwise report the missing access. Do not mark the finding fixed.

unpriced.none: Every model this workspace has run since {since} is priced.

book.title: The price book
book.note: Every provider list price in effect on {at}, and the rates this organization has negotiated, which beat the list price for the same model and class.
book.empty: The price book holds nothing yet. Until it does, no run in this organization can be priced.

dialog.title: Set a negotiated rate
dialog.body: Fill in the classes your contract names. Each one is written as its own effective-dated row, in the order below, under the one date you give. A rate you set beats the provider list price for that model and class from that date on; the row it supersedes is closed, never overwritten, so a run priced earlier keeps the rate it was priced with.
dialog.aliasesHint: Separate them with commas. Leave it empty to keep the names already stored — an empty list would replace them.
dialog.effectiveFromHint: A UTC day, tomorrow or later. Leave it empty to start now. A rate cannot start in the past: runs already priced keep the rate they were priced with.
dialog.rates: Rates, in US dollars per one million units
dialog.ratesHint: Type the figure the way your contract reads it: 2.40 is $2.40 per million. Leave a class empty to leave it as it is.

errors.providerInvalid: Enter the vendor’s name, up to 128 characters.
errors.modelInvalid: Enter the model id, up to 256 characters.
errors.regionInvalid: A region is at most 64 characters.
errors.aliasesInvalid: Enter up to 32 names, each at most 256 characters.
errors.effectiveFromInvalid: Enter a day as YYYY-MM-DD, or leave it empty to start now.
errors.tokenClassInvalid: That is not a token class the price book prices.
errors.rateInvalid: Enter US dollars per one million units, with at most six decimal places.
errors.ratesEmpty: Fill in at least one class. Nothing was written.

partial.written: In effect now: {classes}. Setting a class again is safe — it supersedes its own row.
partial.noneWritten: Nothing was written. The price book is unchanged.
partial.notWritten: Not written: {classes}. Those classes are still priced as they were.

remove.label: Remove the negotiated rate for {model}, {class}
remove.title: Fall back to the list price
remove.body: Ending your negotiated rate for {model}, {class} means every call from now on is priced at the provider’s list price instead. Nothing is deleted.
remove.kept: The row is closed at this instant and kept, so a run priced before now still names the rate it was priced with. You can negotiate the class again at any time.
remove.submit: End this rate, use the list price
remove.unpriced: Your negotiated rate for {model}, {class} is ended. No list or override price covers this model and class, so calls from now on are UNPRICED, not priced at the list rate, until you set a new rate or a catalog publishes one.
remove.confirmUnpriced: No list or override price covers {model}, {class}. Ending your negotiated rate now, rather than setting a new one first, leaves every call from now on UNPRICED, not priced at the list rate, until you set one.
remove.confirmUnpricedSubmit: End the rate anyway, leave it unpriced
remove.cancelScheduled: Cancel this scheduled rate. The preceding rate continues until the next scheduled rate, if any. Later scheduled rates stay in place.

gateway.title: Gateway models
gateway.note: Model lists apply to routed calls from Claude Code, Codex, and Stella’s Anthropic provider after an upgraded host refreshes its signed mandate. Cursor model calls are not routed. Agent budgets remain separate.
gateway.sessionLimitHint: This legacy value is recorded only. Set an enforced run budget on the agent mandate.
gateway.modelAllowHint: One per line. A trailing * matches by prefix, so claude-opus-* covers every dated build. Leave blank to permit every model unless Permit no models is selected.
gateway.modelDenyHint: One per line, refused whatever the allowed list says. Deny * to refuse every model.
gateway.readOnly: Your role can read this policy. An organization or workspace owner or admin changes it.

errors.sessionLimitInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it blank for no limit.

errors.modelListRequired: Add an allowed or denied model before enabling the lists.
